notes: Master level: 28 course rows recorded in 7 field groups, which is the full DAAD list for intake 2027/2028 (list dated June 2026). The list states no total. Leipzig SEPT and Development Cooperation are two separate entries; the TH Köln entry for NRM, IWRM and REM is one line in the list covering three courses, recorded as three rows.

Compared with the first pass this adds International Education Management (INEMA, PH Ludwigsburg with Helwan University Cairo, social sciences) and names the university of Global Health (University of Bonn, as the list shows).

Language, degree and duration are copied only where the layout of the list makes the row clear; for the Leipzig courses and Development Management (Bochum) the layout is ambiguous, so none is given. Duration is the length without a German language course.
Doctoral level: no course list; DAAD funds doctoral study only in exceptional cases, so no doctoral programmes are recorded.
not_stated: Application deadlines are not in the list itself (each course sets its own; the list says see website of the course).
fetch_problems: The list PDF has no table structure, so rows were read from the text positions on the page; the websites of the individual courses were not opened.
